title: callitriche palustris subsp. polymorpha
intro: Callitriche palustris subsp. polymorpha, commonly known as water starwort, is a plant species that belongs to the family Plantaginaceae. It is valued for its potential health benefits, which include its ability to lower blood sugar levels, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Callitriche palustris subsp. polymorpha include its use as an antidiabetic, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant agent. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other compounds that contribute to its medicinal properties.
